Savannah Boele <s.boele@essb.eur.nl>:
Hi Amin, Next Monday, we will begin the ESM and daily diaries for our four studies (4044, 4045, 4050, 4051). We have already requested participants to share their Avicenna ID with is, so that we can link their personal information, specifically their registered phone number, to their anonymous Avicenna ID. This is necessary to send personalized messages regarding their compliance through WhatsApp during the studies. However, to date, we still do not have each participant's ID. As we are close to starting, we were wondering whether there might be another way to gather their phone numbers. We are unable to locate this information through the researcher's dashboard. We can only see the list of Avicenna IDs. Is there a way to determine which phone number corresponds to each ID? Any assistance you can provide would be much appreciated. Kind regards, Savannah and Rick Dr. Savannah Boele Postdoctoral researcher | Erasmus School of Social and Behavioural Sciences Researcher in project PARADOx | www.paradoxscience.nl/ | Laatste nieuwsbrief Daily parenting dynamics are adolescent-specific: Journal of Youth and Adolescence Working days: Monday, Tuesday, Thursday, & Friday------
